text:
Mara (marketing): Quick creative brief for benchmark launch + webinar funnel. Need: 1 hero (landing), 1 paid hero (1200x628), 6 social cards (1080x1080), 3 inbound tiles (640x640), and a single 2s looping GIF for email. Deadline: 4 workdays. High priority.

Joey (design): Copy variants and any motion constraints?

Mara (marketing): Copy options: H1 "Serving wins: lower spend, steady latency" OR H2 "Optimize inference cost + SLAs". Sub: "Webinar: live demo + benchmark deep dive". CTAs: "Save your seat" / "See the numbers" / "Get results". GIF only for email (sparkline anim).

Sam (product): Sparkline sample data (use for animation):
`tokens_per_sec: [820, 960, 940, 1010, 980]`
`cost_per_1k_usd: [1.05, 0.88, 0.92, 0.79, 0.84]`
Add footnote: "Internal benchmark on sample workloads; results vary. n=5 runs."

Nina (growth): Routing: cost -> /demo?utm=cost_apr, latency -> /demo?utm=latency_apr, learn -> /demo?utm=learn_apr. Each tile must embed `utm_campaign=bench_apr_v1` and unique utm_content. Export naming: campaign|variant|creativeid.

Tess (creative): Accessibility: prefer high-contrast combos. For a dark tile try #081226 bg + white text, accent sparkline #4FD1C5. Buttons: 16px semibold, 6px radius. GIF: single-element motion only.

Elena (legal): No comparative claims or competitor names. Numeric claims need attribution and sample size. Include methodology text exactly: "Methodology: internal benchmark on sample workloads  details at redwood.com/benchmarks" in landing copy. Tag me in Figma for final sign-off.

BrandOps Bot: Reminder: attach brand palette and font weight spec in Figma. Run contrast plugin before export.

Joey (design): Will upload static comps by tomorrow 10:00 PT (three creative variants + landing hero). GIF prototype (sparkline anim) by Wed afternoon. I will add an artboard named LEGAL_REVIEW with the locked methodology text.

Mara (marketing): Perfect  Thanks team  Ill route to growth + legal after mock upload.
